reference_summary: Binary search requires sorted data, compares the target with the middle item, discards the impossible half, and repeats until found or empty. Bubble sort compares adjacent items, swaps out-of-order pairs, and repeats passes until sorted. Recursion needs a base case and a self-call that moves toward it.
